name: Classical Forest Green & Gold Quranic Art
short_desc: Bring scholarly elegance home with this hand-painted Quranic calligraphy piece on forest green fabric. Detailed with gold corner filigree, dark wood framing, and a gloss varnish seal, it elevates executive offices and formal sitting rooms.
seo_title: : Classical Forest Green & Gold Quranic Art – Hand-Painted Acrylic Calligraphy with Varnish
description:
Imbue your room with dignity and classical Islamic art traditions through this refined framed canvas artwork. The piece presents a sacred Quranic passage written in bold, masterfully proportioned black script with delicate gold vocalization marks.

Painted using fine acrylic paints, the script rests on a deep forest green linen-textured backdrop framed by an elegant gold pin-stripe border with delicate floral corner filigree.

A protective gloss varnish seal shields the entire surface from dust, humidity, and UV damage, ensuring the rich green background and metallic gold flourishes remain vibrant for years.

Framed inside a wide dark walnut frame, this dignified piece fits seamlessly into traditional home libraries, executive study rooms, wood-paneled offices, or formal sitting areas.

Key Specifications & Features:

Medium & Materials: Premium heavy-body acrylic paints on forest green fabric surface

Surface Coating: Protective gloss varnish seal for long-term color preservation

Theme & Script: Classical Quranic passage with gold accents

Color Palette: Deep forest green background, bold black lettering, and metallic gold filigree

Style: Traditional Scholarly / Classical Framed Art

Ideal Placement: Executive office, home library, formal sitting room, or study desk wall
